item.title: Trump 2.0 stock market compared with predecessors
item.description: Data: Financial Modeling Prep; Chart: Erin Davis/Axios Visuals. The stock market soared during the first 20 months of President Trump's second term.

item.title: GOP turns to football for midterm TV ad push
item.description: Republicans seeking midterm momentum are investing heavily in football, spending millions on ads during major NFL broadcasts.

item.title: Trump bars CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House
item.description: President Trump said Friday he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House effective immediately, escalating his long-running battles.
